purpose: Keep public names, machine identifiers, file names, and migration aliases stable as AgentOS grows.

naming_rules.public_names: Title Case for named concepts; avoid product, provider, or transport assumptions.
naming_rules.machine_ids: Uppercase snake case for stable role, state, and disposition enums; lowercase dot-separated kebab segments for question and object IDs.
naming_rules.files: Lowercase kebab case with a stable semantic noun; retain a compatibility file when a published path has already been consumed.
naming_rules.articles: Stable numeric identity plus a short lowercase kebab slug; never renumber an accepted article.
naming_rules.aliases: Aliases normalize to one canonical identity before validation and are retained only for migration or read compatibility.
naming_rules.project_context: Project names, repositories, providers, deployments, domains, and owner identities are data, never canonical AgentOS names.

BOOTSTRAP.meaning: The one setup controller that discovers, asks, compiles, and seals project configuration before a campaign.

BOOTSTRAP_INTERVIEW.meaning: The compact owner-question catalog and compiler used by Bootstrap.

BOOTSTRAP_DISCOVERY.meaning: Secret-free, read-only inspection that supplies facts and candidate interpretations to Bootstrap.

AUTHORITY_CORPUS.meaning: The project-bound source of truth compiled from governance plus project context.

PROJECT_CONTEXT.meaning: Typed project facts, intent, boundaries, preferences, and external bindings supplied to governance.

CAMPAIGN_ORCHESTRATOR.meaning: The campaign-scoped liveness, custody, dependency, and coherence owner.

FEATURE_ORCHESTRATOR.meaning: The feature-scoped owner that directly supervises feature work and any leased Platform Agent.

PLATFORM_AGENT.meaning: An on-demand, feature-exclusive capability worker reused by that feature during the current campaign.

AUDITOR.meaning: An independent read-only verifier; audit workers are optional children, not a standing review wave.

NEXT_CAMPAIGN_CANDIDATE.meaning: A durable, content-addressed packet for a separately admitted future campaign; it creates no successor session or lease by itself.

RUNTIME.meaning: The exact deployment, rollback, and live-operation control identity.

GOVERNANCE_VALUE_TEST.meaning: The test that permits governance work only when it advances product progress, trustworthy proof, causal repair, continuity, or a genuine authority decision.
